dict.string: A small gun that shoots small bullets, and might even kill small things.
A rapid fire gun that shoots small bullets.
A rapid fire gun that shoots big bullets.
A rapid fire gun that shoots huge slugs.
A massive multi-barrelled gun that rains death and destruction upon your enemies.
Multiple Gatling Guns merged into one weapon give you the most destructive bullet hose in galaxy.
A small missle which clumsily seeks its targets.
The arrow missle has a powerful steering thrusters and the ability to launch quickly.
This heat seeking missle travels a long range and packs a powerful warhead.
Shurikens are small missles can launch quickly and have great tracking.
Large and slow bomb that nukes a huge area with great force and shield damage on detonation.
Launches small slugs at very high speeds.
Spews high speed slugs designed for armor penetration.
Magnetic repulsion launch huge and massive slugs into your enemies with frightening velocity.
This huge magnetic tube can launch radioactive slugs that are as massive as some small ships.
This pair of Gauss Cannons will quickly punch huge holes in any armor hit.
Fires slivers of razor sharp crystal.
These crystal shards move slow but are massive and sharp.
Large crystal blades that can punch holes in almost any armor.
Razor crystalline shards that are as sharp as they are huge.
If these shards were any more massive they would have a gravity well.
A slow beam of charged energy.
A thin beam of pure energy.
Negative ion pulse beam with a good range.
Tons of superheated gasses are released all at once in a tight beam.
This beam will hit your enemies with enough antimatter to vaporize a small moon.
This mine will fragment into thousands of tiny shards on impact.
Explodes in a volley of large sharp shards.
Any ship that stumbles into of these will have its insides introduced to the vacuum.
Hurls small spines that seek the warmth of nearby ships.
Flings armor pentrating quills that can seek targets who dont move too fast.
Launches huge spikes that can seek the life forces of your foes.
A simple spore with a small explosive payload. It has a decent tracking ability.
A small spore which phases out shields. It has a decent tracking ability.
A spore with a payload of pure plasma which devastates enemy shields. It has a decent tracking ability.
This worm contains a potent explosion chemical cocktail. It has a decent tracking ability.
The Kinetic Pollup does less damage but packs a large force when it strikes a target. It has a decent tracking ability.
This weapon has a huge pocket of extremely corrosive acid. It has a decent tracking ability.
As you poke this gland a fountain of slimy corrosive residue leaving you with minor chemical burns.
Produces a cone of energy that can quickly damage weak shields.
A sac that produces large amounts of sulfuric acid that can eat through even thick armor.
Evolved from a sweat gland, the Plasma Pore can erupt a large stream of short range ionized gas.
When this sphincter clenches anything near its orifice is quickly melted by an extremely potent hydrochloric acid.
Used by Lanaar miners, this thin constant beam can slice small objects right in half.
Designed to cut large objects into small manageable chunks.
Relentless stream of ionized gases can make quick works of medium sized ships.
Little more than a cold fusion reactor with an output port where intense energy streams out in a focused beam.
This laser literally tears spacetime, sapping all energy and scrambling the atoms of anything it hits.
Rapid fire seeking pods that pull your enemy toward you.
A pulsing beam of force that pushes away your enemies.
This energy bomb seeks targets in any direction and releases huge kinetec force on contact.
A shockwave of pure kinetic energy is emitted from your location pushing all other ships away from you.
A large and slow bomb that pulls all nearby enemies to the point of impact.
